title: Efficiency Mode and Mileage Impressions
summary: Reviews in this topic mostly describe satisfaction with efficient mode, fuel or battery efficiency, and mileage-related driving behavior, with a small number of complaints or unclear remarks.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise efficient mode preferences, strong fuel or battery efficiency, and acceptable miles shown or driven in efficient mode.

negative.summary: The negative review says the vehicle feels less efficient than the owner's previous electric vehicle.

mixed.summary: The mixed review combines a noted efficient-mode display behavior with dislike of having to use Efficient mode.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention use of efficiency mode or fuel-efficiency-related context without enough detail to confirm clear satisfaction or dissatisfaction.

limitations: Several fragments are brief or lack context, so some efficiency mentions cannot be classified beyond undetermined.
The topic mixes driving-mode preference, displayed miles, and general fuel or battery efficiency rather than one single tightly defined issue.
Samples are stratified and not representative of the full owner population.
